in_marathi.name: Ayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘आयण’ (Ayana), meaning ‘breath’ or ‘wind’. In Hindu mythology, Ayan is the name of a deity associated with wind and change. It is also a popular name for boys in India.
